resources.string:
What MAEHR FIT does with your health data:

• MAEHR FIT reads from Health Connect: heart rate, heart rate variability, resting heart rate, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, skin temperature, sleep and exercise.

• Your data stays on this device. The app sends nothing to the internet and shares nothing with third parties.

• MAEHR FIT writes nothing to Health Connect.

• You can revoke access in Health Connect at any time and delete all data in the app under “Data”.

• MAEHR FIT shows measurements and trends. It is not a medical device and gives no medical advice.
